Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
So pretty... like a pink tunnel.
Yeah, it is.
Did you know？ Cherry blossoms apparently give off something that makes you tipsy.
...What？
Something that makes you tipsy. That's why cherry blossom viewing gets so lively.
I feel like I've heard that before...
Really？ Did I tell you？
Um... I don't really remember.
Hehe. Maybe we're both tipsy？
From the cherry blossoms？
Yes. On the cherry blossoms.
Anegasaki
Look, it's cool in the shade of the trees.
Okay. I'll come over there now.
Ah... Wait.
Hehe. Found it～.
What？ A cicada shell？
Yeah. When I was a child, I thought this thing was mysterious. It was hollow and it didn't move.
You mean you didn't know cicadas molt？
Right. So I thought they were super well-made bug toys that broke and got thrown away.
This many？ And stuck on trees on purpose？
Yeah.
If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ were the detective in a mystery, every case would go unsolved.
Geez. I keep saying it was when I was little.
Amazing. Everything's bright yellow.
Anegasaki
Doesn't "bright yellow" sound kind of unpoetic？
But isn't this exactly what autumn feels like？
That's true, but.
Ah, right. Speaking of autumn, when you were little, didn't you pick up ginkgo nuts under the ginkgo trees？
Hmm. Did I？
It's so nostalgic. Maybe autumn makes you remember the past. They even call it autumn nostalgia.
Ah, I guess so.
Walking side by side like this... I wonder if someday we'll look back on it as a memory？
Yeah. Maybe.
I hope someday we can reminisce together like this again.
Anegasaki
The leaves have all fallen, huh.
The bare trees of winter, huh.
Even like this, they're actually still alive. Isn't that amazing？
Plants have amazing vitality.
Yes. Hepaticas come up even before hibernating animals wake.
Is that so？
Huh？ Was I wrong？
I don't remember, but now I can't wait for spring.
I like winter too.
Really？
Yes. When we snuggle up, it's warm and feels nice.
Whoa...！
Anegasaki
Ah！ Are you okay!?
I'm fine. I just tripped a little... ow！
Don't push yourself. You should rest a bit.
But...
...Now, your hand.
I'm fine, I can walk on my own.
I told you not to push yourself. So, here.
...All right.
Then, let's go.
Yeah.
I only come to shrines for New Year's, so this feels kind of weird.
Anegasaki
Really？ I come here quite a bit.
Huh. So it brings you good luck？
Yes. You see... ah, never mind. Forget it.
What？ Just say it.
Mm... you won't laugh？
I won't. I absolutely won't.
You see... um... the day I confessed, I came here before that, too.
That's...
Okay, forget it, forget it. No more questions. Ugh, so embarrassing.
When I was a kid, I couldn't tell shrines and temples apart.
Anegasaki
Really？ The one with the torii is the shrine, you know？
Not like that. Like, the difference between Shinto gods and Buddhas...
Ah. But apparently long ago, gods and Buddhas were all lumped together.
Really？ Huh.
Apparently when Buddhism came to Japan, they treated the Buddha as a "foreign god."
And？
Sorry. That's all I know.
So it doesn't connect to horror after that？
Geez, I don't only talk about that kind of thing.
Anegasaki
Hmm...
What's wrong？ Didn't you like it？
Well... more like... I'm not convinced. Why doesn't the hero go after her right there？
Was something weird？
For the story, it's not weird. If he went after her there, he wouldn't end up with the heroine.
Right. It wouldn't be a happy ending.
But I don't get how the hero feels, not going after her. Normally you'd go after her, right？
Now that you mention it, that's true.
Right!? I think he'd choose her right there. I don't get why he doesn't.
Do you always think about things like that while watching？
Huh!? Ah... yes, probably... is that weird？
No. I just thought it's very ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Huh... ah, what... aww. Geez.
I'm beat...
Anegasaki
What's wrong？ Didn't you like it？ I thought it was super fun...
No, it was fun, but I got tired just watching...
Yes. It's amazing, and cool. I can't believe he can move like that.
So as a woman, do you find macho guys like that attractive？
Huh？ Ah... hehe.
The one I like is the kind of guy who gets tired watching an action movie.
Anegasaki
Ah, that was funny. I laughed so hard for the first time in a while.
I thought ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was funnier, though.
Eh？ What about me？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ doesn't usually laugh that hard.
Ah... Did I laugh with my mouth wide open？
Yeah.
No way... no, aww, geez.
Kidding, kidding. Sorry. You covered your mouth properly and laughed "ohohoho."
Ugh... that's somehow embarrassing too.
It's fine. You were cute even laughing hard.
But you were looking at my embarrassing face the whole time. Ugh.
Anegasaki
That was fun. I haven't seen an animated movie in a theater in ages. Especially since theatrical anime is still mostly for kids.
I forgot they were drawings and got totally absorbed. They seemed alive.
Apparently the word "animate" itself originally means "to give life."
Is that so？
I guess they named it animation because the drawings move like they're alive.
Then today's movie really was animated.
Yes. Seems so.
Anegasaki
That was amazing. I didn't expect it to end like that.
Huh. You're unusually excited？
Yes. Intellectual excitement, they call it？ My brain feels good！ ...Something like that, I guess.
Come to think of it, I couldn't enjoy sci-fi like that when I was a kid.
Right. Maybe we were just impressed by the visuals and didn't understand the story.
Guess this is one of those things you can enjoy once you grow up.
Hehe, maybe. If we can stay together even after we grow up, maybe there'll be even more we can enjoy than now.
I hope we can.
Th-that was scary. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, how are you so calm？
Anegasaki
That's not true. I was scared.
But why do you like horror, anyway？
Hmm, I like the scary stuff, but in horror, the characters stand up to it, right？ That kind of thing...
Huh. ...Then, could it be you can't handle true ghost stories？
Ah... no. Those are a no. Those are just plain scary.
Huh. You know, I know a super scary story. It's the story of Kijima-san...
Noooo！ Noooo！ No, stop！
Ow...
Ah... I'm sorry！ I just...!!
No... my bad. Haha...
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is surprisingly scary...)
Hyah！
Anegasaki
Amazing, amazing！ Four strikes in a row！
I'm just knocking them down with brute force. Okay, it's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s turn.
Yes. I don't have strength, so I'll do my best with technique.
...Your techniques？
Making the ball go hit the pins on its own is amazing technique, right？
...It's a mystery throw, for sure.
Results are everything. Here I go.
(...How does that turn into a strike...)
Anegasaki
Hyaah！
Ah...
Ah, no. Not that way！ Curve！ Curve！
A strike!? From there!?
Aha, did you see？ Did you see it？
Wow, curving from way over there...
Ehehe. Amazing？ Amazing？
Yeah, amazing.
Like someone who goes around the world to buy the most far-flung souvenir, and ends up buying croquettes at the shop next door？
(I have no idea what that comparison means...)
Anegasaki
You really are too good for me. Maybe I need to practice more.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s mystery throw is amazing in its own way, I think.
Mystery throw... is that a compliment？
I've never seen anything like it.
I see. But you can't experience that with anyone else, right？ Isn't it fun？
It is fun, but... I don't know whether to be happy about it.
If you're having fun, I'm having fun.
Come on. One more game.
Anegasaki
Phew...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you were really into it. That surprised me.
...But, I'm done. I'm all out of energy.
Looks like it. Can you walk okay？
Mm... might be tough. I'm worn out.
Hey... can you hold me up for a bit？
Yeah, sure.
Then, just a little... just a little.
Whoa！ H-hey... you're close...
Ehehe. Don't you like this？
It's not that I hate it...
...Hehe. Thanks for holding me up.
Anegasaki
How was it？
It was really great...
Wasn't it？ It's less like music and more like... it's talking to you.
Yeah. I really get it now.
I'm glad. Not many people agree with me.
Really？
I don't know if it's the right interpretation, but that's how it sounds to me.
I see.
Yes. ...Ufufu. I'm a little happy about this.
Ah, it was fun.
Anegasaki
Hip-hop is so straightforward, huh. Like raw words riding right on the rhythm.
Yeah. I agree.
Hey. Do you know the difference between hip-hop and rap？
Umm... They're both the same, aren't they？
Hehe. You see, hip-hop is a culture.
Is that so？
Yes, a youth culture from New York. Rap is a musical technique, and hip-hop music is music that uses it.
You know stuff like that... I'm surprised.
Hehe, I studied up a bit.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you okay？ Here, this way.
Anegasaki
Ah... yes. Phew, we made it out...
You okay？ That was a crazy crowd.
Yes. She's popular, I didn't know.
Come to think of it, you hear her songs all over town.
That's right...
Ugh, I let my guard down.
So, how was it？
I came without really knowing her, but I'm glad I did. I think I get why she sells so well.
Actually, me too. I'm thinking of buying her CD.
Hehe... then when you go buy it, let's go together？
Yeah. Sure.
Anegasaki
Ah, that was so funny. My stomach hurts.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you don't usually laugh that hard, huh.
Yes. But it's not like I'm gloomy, okay？ I laugh when it's time to laugh.
I know. So, which one was the funniest？
Let's see... um, what was his name, the one who talked nonstop.
That was amazing, huh. How does he breathe？
Who knows...？
It's really amazing that he can carry it that long just with a string of rhyming words.
Yeah. They say it's harder to make people laugh than to make them cry.
Today I learned that if you want to make people laugh, just acting silly isn't enough.
(...What are you planning to do with that lesson？)
Anegasaki
You okay？ Need a handkerchief？
No, I'm fine. I have one...
You were touched？
Yes. It was such a good story.
Yeah. They made us laugh that much, and then made the ending really moving.
You know, while I was watching, I thought, what if I ended up like the heroine...
Your boyfriend dies？ ...Hey, that's me！
Please, don't die, okay？ Don't leave me alone, okay？
...Yeah, I won't die. I'll never leave ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ alone.
Yeah.
Anegasaki
How was it？ Did I sing okay？
How do I put it... amazing.
Even I'm surprised. I still remember the choreography I learned in elementary school.
It looked just like the idol footage I saw on TV years ago. Really amazing.
When you think about it, it's amazing. Idol singers sing, dance, and smile, all at once.
There's no way I could be an idol singer.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is my idol, though.
Geez. Even so, singing and dancing in public is a no, okay？
Ohh, that was great.
Anegasaki
Hehe... thank you for listening.
Yeah, you're good. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you're a good singer.
Is that so？ When you praise me like that, I get embarrassed.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you're not trying to sing well, are you？
Mm... ah, maybe. While I'm singing, I start feeling what the lyrics feel, I guess.
That's why. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s singing... it reaches my heart.
Well... I'm singing because I want it to reach your heart...
...She turned it around on me. Now I'm the one getting embarrassed.
Hehe.
Anegasaki
Hey, do you know this song？
Ah... Yeah, I know it.
Then, shall I put it in？
But that's a duet, isn't it...？
That's why I asked？ Let's sing together？
That's kind of embarrassing.
It's fine. If you mess up, I'll cover for you.
That's not the point, though...
Hehe. This kind of thing was a dream of mine.
Anegasaki
Wow... Beautiful. The whole city looks like glasswork...
Ah, look over here, you can even see the bay bridge.
Really？ Where？
Ah！ If you stand up suddenly...!!
Eek！
Whoa, whoa！ Whoa!!
Ah... thanks.
You okay？ Didn't bump anything？
Yes. Um... am I heavy？
I'm fine. Can you stand up？
I can, but...
...But？
Just a little... longer... I'd like to stay like this just a little longer...
Anegasaki
We're almost at the top.
Up this high, you can see all the way to the sea.
Yeah. Hey... can I come over there？
Yeah, sure. It'll rock, so be careful.
Thanks. ...Upsy-daisy.
Are you okay？
Yes. I'm okay. Ehe...
Hehe...
What？
Your hair... smells like shampoo...
Anegasaki
Eek！ Aww, I'm scared.
Hey... don't cling to me so much...
But... Ah！ Again！
Hey, give me your hand. Let's hold hands, okay？
Mm. Well, okay.
...I'm calming down.
Good. Then...
Eek！
Are you okay？
Geez... why do they keep scaring us like this？
(Because we're in a haunted house. That's why...)
Whoa！
Anegasaki
Get a grip. Are you okay!?
Not really okay... gah！
Geez. I didn't know you were such a scaredy-cat. Sorry.
...▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, how are you so calm？
I'm scared too... but I can't just leave you alone.
How pathetic... another one!!
Here, hold on to me. Okay？ The exit's almost here.
...Thanks.
Whoa～！ Ahaha！ That's so scary！
Anegasaki
Eek！ We're gonna fly off！
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you okaaay!?
I'm fiiine！ It's not scary at aaall！
Whaaat!? What did you saaay!?
Not scaaary！
I can't heeear you！
With you, nothing's scary at aaall！
Sorryyy. Tell me when it stoooops!!
Hehehe... dummy.
Anegasaki
Ugh, that was scary. Why does everyone want to ride something that scary...
Wasn't it fun？
No. ...It was a little fun. It was thrilling.
Yeah. It was intense. Shall we ride something slower next？
But maybe I'd be fine with one more time.
Besides, we came all this way.
No way...
Want to try it one more time？
(Seriously!?)
Anegasaki
When I was little, I didn't like lively things like this.
Hmm？ Why？
The night after a festival, I happened to pass by the same shrine...
Ah. The difference surprised you？
Yes. It had been so lively the day before. It was dark and quiet, and it scared me.
Then, do you not like this parade either？
No, it's fun. Because I'm with you.
I see.
With you, anything is fun for me.
Anegasaki
Aww... too bad. Ugh.
What？ You can't see it？
Yeah... the crowd's so packed, I can't see. What should we do... give up？
That'd be annoying.
Then... push through the crowd to the front？
Let's try. Stay right behind me.
Yes. Got it.
Hup！ Hup！
Um, me... then I'll push your back.
Al...right. Almost there.
Yay. Are we through？
Phew... I'm a bit tired.
Good work.
Now you can see, right？
Yes. I think I saw something better than the parade. You, being cool.
Oh no... what a crowd. Doesn't look like we'll see it...
Anegasaki
Yes. It's fine.
But you were looking forward to it, right？ Want to sit on my shoulders？
It's fine. You'd get crushed.
I may not look it, but I'm confident in my strength... not really, huh.
Hey. Want to walk around a bit？ All the other guests are gathered at the parade.
...Sure, but. Is that okay with you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yes. For me... as long as you're here, the parade doesn't really matter...
...I see, got it. Let's walk.
Hey... will you hold my hand？
Anegasaki
Are you really going on that giant slide？
Isn't it gonna be fun？
It ends in the pool, right？
Right. So you can relax.
That's exactly why I can't relax...
Can't I just watch？
I think it'd be more fun to slide together.
Hmm... then, just once. Only once, okay？
Thanks！
Geez... like a kid.
Anegasaki
Ugh, geez... I got water up my nose.
Hmm, no good. But it's still hard to believe ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ sinks like a rock.
Aww, geez. Don't keep saying it.
Um... how much do you weigh？
Whaa!? I have to say？ Ugh... come here, I'll whisper.
Okay...
You see... ......
...With that and your height, there's no way you shouldn't float.
Really？
Yeah. Fat is lighter than water, so you should float... wait, what's wrong？
Geez！ Dummy！
Whoa！
Anegasaki
Ahh, we played so much. I'm all wobbly.
Yeah. Being tired after swimming is a special kind of tired. Like going limp...
It feels sooo good. I'd be happy if I just fell asleep like this.
You're going to sleep？
If I fell asleep, what would you do？ Leave me and go home？
No way. I wouldn't do that.
Hehe... good.
I'd just keep watching your sleeping face like this.
Ah, huh, ah. Um. We should head home soon. Yes. No sleeping. Yes.
Anegasaki
There are so many stars...
There might be aliens out there.
Yeah... it wouldn't be strange if there were.
There might be a planet just like Earth, too.
With a country like Japan...
And a town just like this one...
And you'd be there...
Yeah. And ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ would be there too...
Maybe the two of us there are looking up at a planetarium like this, talking about the same thing...
That'd be nice.
Yeah. That'd be really nice...
There really are a lot of stars...
Anegasaki
But this is only a tiny part, right？ There are still countless stars you can't see from Earth...
13.7 billion years ago, it was all born from a single point, they say.
The Big Bang？
Right. The universe, the Earth, us, all born from a single point where there was nothing.
And hundreds of millions of years later... we met.
In this city.
At a family restaurant.
When you think about it, it's mysterious.
Yeah, mysterious.
But... it's kind of wonderful.
Anegasaki
Ah... Hmm... Eh!? Ah, sorry. Did I fall asleep!?
Yeah. You looked like you were sleeping comfortably.
Ah, sorry. I was looking at the stars, and somehow I just...
It's all right. Are you okay？ Can you stand up？
I'm fine... ah, come to think of it, I had a weird dream.
A dream？ You were sound asleep, huh？
Yes. You see, I was Andromeda, about to be eaten by a monster, and you came...
As Perseus？ On Pegasus？
No. ...You were riding a tanuki.
...Why a tanuki!?
Anegasaki
If humanity went extinct...
What？ All of a sudden.
Sorry. Hypothetically. Apparently in just a few years, plants would bury the whole city.
A few years？ Not decades？
Yes, a few years. Roads, buildings, everything.
Really？
My family's garden in the country gets crazy if no one keeps it up, they said. Same thing.
So in the end, if humans disappeared, nature would go back to how it was in no time.
I wouldn't mind if that happened, though.
Why？
As long as you're with me.
Anegasaki
Whoa, this is amazing. This flower. What is it？
Let's see... "Rebellious Spirit." It's in the mallow family.
It's huge！ About 20 centimeters？ Maybe more.
If you put this in your hair, you'd tip over from the weight.
Yeah. Ah, if I'm putting something in my hair, something like this would be nice. Look.
Ah, small and cute. They look like white rabbits too.
Let's see？ The name is... "rabbit moss"？
...Ah. Never mind.
Why？ They're cute.
Because it's a carnivorous plant.
...That explains it.
So many kinds of plants. Oh, this is the waterside plant section.
Anegasaki
The water lilies are pretty. The lotus leaves look like little green tables.
Ah, there's a frog on that leaf.
No way！
What？
I'm... not very good with frogs...
Really？ ...Then I probably shouldn't tell you？
There's another frog by ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s feet...
Noooo！
Whoa！ Don't jump on me all of a sudden！
Anegasaki
Mmm. I was a little moved.
Yeah.
I don't get many chances to listen to classical music, but it's really nice once in a while.
It might be my first time almost crying over music without any lyrics.
Even if it's old, good is good, huh.
When you think about it, it's been handed down for hundreds of years, so maybe that's natural.
What do you mean？
If something survives for later generations, it means someone thought it was worth keeping, right？
Ah, I see. It couldn't survive unless lots of people thought so.
Old things have a reason they've survived all those years.
Oh？ Getting philosophical？
Hehehe.
That was really lively.
Anegasaki
Yes, it was. I've never seen you that into something.
They were really cute, and I get how the fans feel.
Huh？ Ah, I see. They were cute, weren't they.
Um, no. I just mean cute as idols...
I see～, so they're cute～.
But to me, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is way more...
Ufufu, kidding, kidding. Even I have an idol I like.
Who!?
It's a secret♪
(She's still mad after all!?)
Anegasaki
Hmm.
Huh？ Didn't you like it？
No, I did, but...
What？
In musicals, they suddenly start singing in the middle of the play, right？
Well, yeah. When you think about it, it's weird.
But it doesn't look weird at all. That's the mysterious part. It's different from humming without thinking, right？
Yeah. When you put it that way, it is mysterious.
Want to try talking in songs, just us？
...Let's not. Actually doing it would be weird.
Anegasaki
...I was scared.
It sure was intense.
Right. Those bams and booms were so loud. Are they really doing it for real？
Hmm, who knows. Some say there's a script...
But they were really throwing and kicking each other, you know？ And it landed.
...Even if there's a script, I think that's real fighting.
Right, there's no way it doesn't hurt.
I've seen it on TV, but... I feel like I just saw something incredible.
...It was scary, but now I want to see it again.
Yeah. If we get another chance.
But it's still a little scary, I guess.
Aww, so close. Guess we didn't cheer enough.
Anegasaki
Hehe. But it was a close game. Just one run apart, you know？
Right. You don't get to see a pitchers' duel like that often.
Come to think of it, I batted cleanup once, in elementary school. At school.
Huh, that's unexpected.
No, actually, back then I was the tallest in my class. So I guess they had high hopes for me.
How'd you do？
So, not at all. Struck out every at-bat. Without swinging once. Everyone blamed me.
Huh. That's not really ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s fault, though.
That's why I actually hated baseball. But with you, I didn't mind it at all.
I see. Then, come again？
Yes. If we get another chance.
That was a crazy crowd... you okay？
Anegasaki
Yes... but I might be a little tired...
I underestimated doujinshi, but there are this many people making them...
Yeah...
So, did you get anything？
Yes, a book from a movie fan circle.
Horror, I bet.
Yes. Apparently the circle has been going for over 20 years.
Don't tell me... you bought 20 years' worth of doujinshi？
No way... but I'm a little curious...
(Is she going to be okay...)
Anegasaki
Ah, look. You can see the city lights.
Ah, you're right. Pretty amazing.
There's a person at each and every one of those lights...
Yeah.
We were each at our own separate light, too...
Ah... yeah. But we met.
So many coincidences piled up... is that what they call fate？
Yeah, it might be.
But whatever fate brings now, I won't leave your side.
Yeah. Me neither...
Anegasaki
Ah, what？
Seabirds. What are they... seagulls？ Black-tailed gulls？
Ah, ah, ah. They're coming over. Huh？ Ah, what do I do？
Don't they want something to eat？
Huh？ Something to eat？ Um, do I have anything, um...
Find something？
Ah, found it. Here, have some. Ah... huh？
Aww, they left. What were you trying to give them？
A throat lozenge.
...Ah, ahaha.
Anegasaki
Doesn't the sea at night feel scary when you look at it？
Why？
Mm... in the daytime, you only notice the light on the surface, but then you realize there's something below...
Below the surface？
Yes. Meters and meters of water, a huge amount, and a pitch-black bottom where light can't reach...
Thinking about it, it is a little scary.
I start to feel like that might be the sea's true face... so the sea at night scares me.
But with people too, don't you think the ones who've overcome lots of sadness and pain are the most wonderful？
Yes... that's true. I see... that's why the sea in the daytime is so beautiful.
Not scared anymore？
Mm... still a little scared... but yes, I'm okay. Thanks.
Here. I bought it.
Anegasaki
Ah, thanks. Hehehe.
What？
You know, I was wondering why yakisoba eaten at the beach tastes so good.
Or rather, why do they always sell yakisoba？
Come to think of it, there's always yakisoba. Why yakisoba, I wonder.
A mystery.
I do know why there's no takoyaki, though.
Why？
Because angry octopuses would come attack from the sea.
That's ridiculous！
Anegasaki
It's a classic image, but have you ever actually buried someone sleeping in the sand？
Never for real. I see it a lot in dramas, though.
Right？ You don't really get the chance to actually do it.
Want to try it？
Eh？
Come on. I thought of it, after all.
But... you won't sculpt a body below my buried head, will you？
Hmm. ...Maybe I will. Like a two-meter-tall muscleman.
I think I'll pass after all.
Then, what about a tanuki？
That's not the issue.
Anegasaki
That was fun. I feel like I won't want to go home.
Yeah. But even if school's out, we still have work.
Hey. Have you ever wanted to take time off from work？
At Dixie's？ No, never.
I have.
Eh!?
Hehe. Before you came. Standing all day was tough. But since you came, I haven't once.
If I hadn't interviewed at Dixie's, we wouldn't be together like this now, huh.
No. I think we'd have met somewhere else. ...Yes... I'm sure we would have met...
...Shall we go？
Yes, let's go home...
Anegasaki
Mmm, haah... the weather's so nice today, it feels great.
Perfect weather for a walk.
Hehe. Come on. This way！
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!?
Look, today this whole wide beach is all ours！
That's rare... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ being this excited.
Hehe... hyah.
Whoa, you're close. What's up？
Hey, want to go to the water's edge？
What's up with you today？ You seem a little different than usual...
